scope: endpoint-wired finite path only; duplicate mathematical result, one brain node at most
reproduction: For a path of L edges free FK is iid Bernoulli(a). Endpoint identification multiplies the all-open configuration's relative weight by q, giving Radon-Nikodym density [1+(q-1)1_all-open]/[1+(q-1)a^L]. Thus each edge gap is (q-1)(1-a)a^L/[1+(q-1)a^L]>0 and tends to zero.

Direct substitution yields B=log3-(19/12)log2>0 since 3^12>2^19. With t=d^-1 sum cos k_j, symmetry gives I_d=E[t^2/(1-t^2)]>=E[t^2]=1/(2d). The source allowance (2J/3)I_d is at least J/(3d), so at d=3,J0 it exceeds B.
